findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: the entire email is one ; none of its text ('You're Going to Love It Here', body copy, CTAs, legal text) is in the page text. A separate 'Text' tab exists in the toolbar, but the default 'Desktop' view gives screen-reader users only the image's alt (value not recorded in capture).
findings.after: Render the email HTML in an <iframe title="Email: Welcome to Apple Arcade"> by default, or give the image alt="" with an adjacent link 'Read the email as text' pointing to the Text tab
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.5 Images of Text and 1.1.1 Non-text Content: a 3,868px image of text cannot be described by alt text alone.

findings.where: inside the email: footer legal text, tile 04
findings.evidence: Legal lines ('Apple Arcade requires a subscription…', 'All rights reserved. Copyright © 2019 Apple Inc.…') are light grey at about 11px on #f2f2f2 in the image; visually well under 4.5:1. The sweep cannot measure text inside the image.
findings.before: Light grey ~#999 small legal text on light grey
findings.after: Legal text at least #6e6e73 on #f2f2f2 (about 4.6:1) and 12px minimum
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); estimated from pixels, not measured.

findings.evidence: dom-1440 text: each of the 8 cards has a 'Save Email' control; out of context a links/buttons list reads 'Save Email' ×8 with no email named.
findings.after: <button aria-label="Save email: Your next trip supports free emergency housing">Save Email</button>
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.6 Headings and Labels / 2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only, AAA); 4.1.2 for button names that repeat.

strengths: A 'Text' view of the email is offered in the toolbar (Desktop / Code / Text / Info).
Breadcrumb is in a <nav> with an ordered list.
lang='en' and a descriptive title are set.
not_investigated: Alt value of the email image (not recorded in the DOM capture; sweep img_alt did not flag it)
Live keyboard behaviour of the 'Find inspiration' / 'Create emails' <details> menus and the Ctrl K search
Sweep Floor hits (focus covered by sticky header, missing main/h1, breadcrumb contrast 3.95:1) agree with tile 00
